name: 44145 · Westlake, OH
findings: ZIP 44145 (Westlake) has 216 nonprofit organizations. 101 of them (47%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 88 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (24% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 44145 (Westlake) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 44145 (Westlake) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.6 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 88 organizations here; 29% of all organizations here have no identified type.
